Copy the course's files into your project

Source: R/course-files.R
copy_course_files.Rd

Copies every file listed by sais_example() into a folder of your project, and makes the folder if it is not there yet. After that the files are yours: read them with readxl::read_excel() or readr::read_csv(), as you would a file you downloaded. Nothing is fetched from the internet.

Usage

copy_course_files(to = "data", overwrite = TRUE)

Arguments

to

The folder to copy into. In the course this is here::here("data"), the data folder of your project.

overwrite

Replace files that are already there? TRUE by default, so a damaged copy is easy to repair.

Value

The paths of the copies, invisibly. A message says how many files were copied and where.

Examples

folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "data")
copy_course_files(folder)
#> Copied 9 course files to /tmp/RtmpYeqS5P/data
list.files(folder)
#> [1] "owid_co2_per_capita.csv"        "owid_renewable_electricity.csv"
#> [3] "wb-country-classification.xlsx" "wdi_education_spending.csv"    
#> [5] "wdi_electricity_access.csv"     "wdi_health_spending.csv"       
#> [7] "wdi_life_expectancy.csv"        "wdi_poverty.csv"               
#> [9] "wdi_primary_completion.csv"
